title: Atlas DataFlow Execution Contract
description: Schema defining execution_contract.v1 — the machine-readable contract governing training preparation, runtime inference, and contract projections. Execution-only fields that drive training are explicitly separated from runtime/public projection fields. Human-facing field descriptions, validation hints, and review notes from the human-facing contract draft (M22) are deliberately excluded — those belong to the promotion validator (M23-02) as reviewed human intent, not as executable operational rules.

contract_version.description: Fixed contract schema version identifier. Must always equal 'execution_contract.v1'. Used to detect contract version incompatibilities during promotion validation (M23-02) and projection derivation (M23-04). Not a semantic version — the runtime contract projection carries its own schema_version.

dataset_id.description: Dataset identifier. Must match the dataset slug used in the contracts directory (e.g., 'bank-marketing'). Used to associate this execution contract with its dataset-specific subdirectory and runtime contract instance.

target_column.description: Name of the column to predict. Must not appear in feature_columns or ignored_columns. Execution-only — not projected into the runtime contract features list, since the target is never an inference input.

feature_columns.description: Ordered list of column names used as model inputs. Must be disjoint from ignored_columns and must not include target_column. Each name must have a corresponding entry in feature_definitions. Projected into the runtime contract features list via M23-04 projection derivation.

ignored_columns.description: Columns present in the dataset but excluded from both training and inference. Must not overlap with feature_columns or target_column. Execution-only — not projected into the runtime or public contract.

required_columns.description: Subset of feature_columns that must be present in every inference payload. Projected into the runtime contract as feature.required: true. Must be a subset of feature_columns.

optional_columns.description: Subset of feature_columns that may be absent from an inference payload without triggering a validation failure. Projected into the runtime contract as feature.required: false. Must be a subset of feature_columns. The union of required_columns and optional_columns must equal feature_columns.

feature_definitions.description: Per-feature type and domain constraint definitions, keyed by feature name. Each key must be a name declared in feature_columns. Provides the type and domain information required to derive the runtime contract feature list in M23-04. Only feature_columns entries are permitted as keys — target_column and ignored_columns must not appear here. Human-facing descriptions, validation hints, and review notes from the human-facing contract draft are deliberately absent — those are reviewed intent (M22), not executable rules.

missing_value_policy.description: Per-feature missing value handling strategy, keyed by feature name. Each key must be a name declared in feature_columns. Governs pipeline preprocessing only — not runtime inference behavior. Human-facing 'validation_hint' fields from the M22 human-facing contract draft are deliberately not carried here.

categorical_encoding_policy.description: Default encoding strategy applied to all categorical features. Execution-only — governs training preprocessing, not public-facing projection. Not projected into the runtime or public contract.

numeric_handling.description: Numeric feature preprocessing approach applied to all numeric features before training. Execution-only — not projected into the runtime or public contract.

allowed_transformations.description: List of column transformations permitted under this contract. An empty array means no transformations beyond encoding and scaling are applied. Execution-only.

split_policy.description: Dataset partitioning configuration for training, validation, and testing phases. Execution-only — not projected into the runtime or public contract.

random_seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility across training runs. Null indicates non-deterministic training. Execution-only.

primary_metric.description: Primary evaluation metric used to select the best model checkpoint during training. Execution-only — not projected into the runtime or public contract.

secondary_metrics.description: Candidate secondary evaluation metrics computed during training for monitoring. May be empty. Execution-only.

modeling_constraints.description: Constraints bounding the model family selection space and training strategy. Does not select a specific model — constrains what is permissible for this dataset. Execution-only.

result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0108: optional, backward-compatible normalized binary-result semantics. Present only on new binary execution contracts with a reviewed, approved binary_result_semantics_intent; strictly validated when present. Excludes authoring-only fields such as review status/notes — those remain in the dataset modeling intent, not here.

model_source_mode.description: Project Spec S0157: optional, backward-compatible explicit model-source declaration. Absent means atlas_internal_training (legacy behavior, unchanged). validated_external_fitted_model is only ever an explicit declaration -- never inferred from model_family, modeling_constraints, or any other field -- and is rejected by the governed training entrypoint (pipeline/training.py) before estimator construction or fit.

feature_definition.description: Execution-level definition of a single feature column. Provides the type and optional domain constraints used to derive the runtime contract feature entry in M23-04. Human-facing descriptions and validation hints from the M22 human-facing contract draft are deliberately excluded — this schema encodes executable operational rules only, not reviewed human intent.

type.description: Feature type. Bounded vocabulary matching the runtime contract convention. Projected into runtime_contract feature.type via M23-04.

domain_constraints.description: Optional value domain constraints. Shape is determined by the feature type: numeric features use numeric_domain_constraints (min/max); categorical features use categorical_domain_constraints (values list). Must be absent for boolean features. Projected into runtime_contract feature.domain_constraints via M23-04.

input_policy.description: Project Spec S0156: optional, backward-compatible runtime input-normalization policy, distinct from the generic training missing_value_policy above. Carried verbatim into the runtime contract projection. Absent for every feature that does not explicitly declare one.

numeric_domain_constraints.description: Value range constraints for numeric features. Mirrors the runtime contract convention to allow direct projection into runtime_contract feature.domain_constraints.

categorical_domain_constraints.description: Enumerated accepted-value guidance for categorical features. Mirrors the runtime contract convention to allow direct projection into runtime_contract feature.domain_constraints. Exactly one of the legacy 'values' vocabulary and the Project Spec S0156 'known_values' vocabulary may be declared -- both present simultaneously is a contradictory dual declaration and is rejected structurally.

values.description: Legacy: non-empty list of accepted string values for this categorical feature. Absence of validation_behavior alongside 'values' preserves the existing closed-domain (reject_unknown) rejection semantics.

known_values.description: Project Spec S0156: non-empty, typed list of known values for this categorical feature -- rendering/documentation/evidence guidance, independent from validation_behavior. Every item must share the declared categorical_value_type scalar type; booleans are never accepted as integer known values.

categorical_value_type.description: Project Spec S0156: the declared scalar type of this categorical feature's values. Required whenever known_values is declared.

validation_behavior.description: Project Spec S0156: explicit runtime unknown-category behavior. reject_unknown preserves the existing closed-domain behavior; ignore_and_report accepts a correctly-typed unknown value, preserves it unchanged, and emits a bounded UNKNOWN_CATEGORY_ACCEPTED observation. Never inferred from model family or dataset slug.

input_policy.description: Project Spec S0156: runtime input-normalization policy for a single feature, distinct from generic training missing_value_policy. Every listed behavior must be explicit and schema-validated.

conditional_blank_normalization.description: Project Spec S0156: a deterministic, side-effect-free conditional blank-input normalization rule. Distinct from generic learned missing-value imputation -- no learned strategy is ever applied here. A feature carrying this policy may remain required: true while still accepting an explicitly declared blank representation only under its declared condition.

accepted_representation.description: The only accepted blank input representation: a string that is empty after trimming leading/trailing whitespace.

when.description: The deterministic equality condition that must hold against another declared feature for the blank representation to be accepted.

materialized_value.description: The fixed constant value the accepted blank representation is normalized to when the condition holds. Never learned or inferred.

otherwise.description: Behavior when the condition does not hold: the blank representation is rejected with a stable, dedicated conditional-missing validation failure.

null_behavior.description: JSON null is never reclassified as an accepted blank representation, regardless of the condition.

equality_condition.description: Project Spec S0156: a bounded, deterministic equality comparison against another declared feature. Never an arbitrary expression, regex program, callable reference, or code string.

field.description: Name of another declared feature (must exist in feature_columns and must not reference the feature that owns this condition).

value.description: The comparison value. Must be compatible with the referenced feature's declared scalar type.

missing_value_strategy.description: Missing value handling strategy for a single feature: mean/median/mode imputation, constant fill, or row exclusion from the training dataset.

categorical_encoding.description: Encoding strategy for categorical features. onehot: one-hot encoding; ordinal: integer ordinal encoding; target_encode: mean-target encoding; binary: binary encoding.

numeric_handling_strategy.description: Preprocessing approach for numeric features. standardize: z-score scaling (zero mean, unit variance); normalize: min-max scaling to [0, 1]; passthrough: no scaling applied.

transformation.description: Permitted column transformation. log1p: natural log of (1 + x); sqrt: square root; clip: clip to domain_constraints bounds; passthrough: no transformation.

split_policy.description: Dataset split configuration. The three ratios must sum to 1.0 (enforced by the training pipeline, not by this schema).

strategy.description: Split strategy. stratified: preserves class distribution of target_column in each split; random: uniform random split without class stratification.

train_ratio.description: Proportion of the dataset allocated to the training split.

val_ratio.description: Proportion of the dataset allocated to the validation split. May be zero if no validation split is required.

test_ratio.description: Proportion of the dataset allocated to the test split.

metric.description: Evaluation metric identifier. Scoped to Atlas classification use cases. roc_auc: area under ROC curve; f1: F1 score; accuracy: classification accuracy; log_loss: cross-entropy loss; pr_auc: area under precision-recall curve (this project's existing internal-training identifier, computed via average_precision_score). Project Spec S0157 additions for the external fitted-model evidence profile: average_precision (a distinct canonical identifier from pr_auc -- both remain valid and are never silently translated into one another; pr_auc is this project's established internal-training name, average_precision is the external evidence profile's own name for the same class of ranking metric, kept separate so provenance is never lost); precision; recall; f2 (F-beta with beta=2, recall-weighted); balanced_accuracy; brier_score (mean squared error of predicted probabilities, lower_is_better semantics, distinct from log_loss). Project Spec S0216 explicit multiclass-native aggregate additions: f1_macro, f1_weighted, precision_macro, recall_macro -- each a distinct, explicit multiclass aggregate identifier, never a silent reinterpretation of the binary-era f1/precision/recall ids (those never carry multiclass averaging semantics). Project Spec S0223 continuous-regression vocabulary additions: r2 (coefficient of determination; higher_is_better), mae (mean absolute error; lower_is_better), rmse (root mean squared error; lower_is_better) -- contract/training-policy vocabulary only; selecting r2/mae/rmse at contract-policy level does not imply metric computation support. The governed internal training entrypoint (pipeline/training.py) computes roc_auc/f1/accuracy/log_loss/pr_auc for binary native training and additionally accuracy/balanced_accuracy/f1_macro/f1_weighted/precision_macro/recall_macro/log_loss for fixed-configuration native multiclass training; every other identifier is schema-valid vocabulary for evidence artifacts and fails closed with a stable unsupported_metric error if ever selected as an internal training primary_metric outside those two governed sets. pipeline/training.py does not compute r2/mae/rmse as of S0223.

modeling_constraints.description: Constraints bounding the model selection space for this dataset. Does not select a model — constrains what model families and training strategies are permissible. Scoped to Atlas classification use cases.

allowed_model_families.description: Non-empty list of permitted model family identifiers. Training must use only families declared here. Scoped to the Atlas classification model families — broader ML families are out of scope for this contract. Project Spec S0157 introduced hist_gradient_boosting as vocabulary for a validated_external_fitted_model contract's declared family. Project Spec S0216 additionally authorizes it for Atlas-native multiclass training: pipeline/training.py's internal supported-family registry now constructs and fits a HistGradientBoostingClassifier only when task_type is classification, modeling_constraints.selection_mode is fixed_configuration, and fixed_model_configuration.model_family is hist_gradient_boosting. Atlas never fits hist_gradient_boosting for a binary/legacy selection_mode.

no_automl.description: When true, prohibits automated model selection and hyperparameter search (AutoML). Training must use one of the allowed_model_families with explicitly configured parameters.

max_training_time_seconds.description: Optional upper bound on training wall-clock time in seconds. Null means no time constraint is imposed.

selection_mode.description: Project Spec S0216: optional, backward-compatible native training selection strategy. Absent preserves the historical evaluate_allowed_families behavior (train and compare every allowed_model_families candidate, select by primary_metric). fixed_configuration requires exactly one fixed_model_configuration entry whose model_family also appears exactly once in allowed_model_families, and authorizes no model/hyperparameter selection at all -- the fixed configuration is fit as-is.

fixed_model_configuration.description: Project Spec S0216: required exactly when selection_mode is fixed_configuration; absent otherwise. Bounded, explicit fixed hyperparameter configuration for one model family -- never a callable, module path, or class string.

Project Spec S0216: a single bounded fixed model configuration for modeling_constraints.selection_mode = fixed_configuration. hyperparameters is discriminated strictly by model_family -- only the named model_family's own allowed hyperparameter shape may match, and it must be complete (no partial supply): unknown hyperparameter names or callable/module/class-string values are always rejected.

model_family.description: Project Spec S0216 introduces the first bounded fixed-parameter family. random_state is never part of hyperparameters -- it always remains governed by the top-level execution-contract random_seed.

hist_gradient_boosting_hyperparameters.description: Project Spec S0216: the complete, explicit set of whitelisted hist_gradient_boosting hyperparameters for a fixed_configuration native multiclass run. No other estimator parameter name is ever accepted, and no field here may ever be a callable, module path, or class string.

result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0223: closed discriminated union of normalized machine-readable result semantics. Exactly one of binary_result_semantics (Project Spec S0108), multiclass_result_semantics (Project Spec S0207), or continuous_regression_result_semantics (Project Spec S0223) may match -- all three definitions are additionalProperties: false with disjoint required-field shapes, so a document can never satisfy more than one branch or mix fields across them.

binary_result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0108: normalized machine-readable binary-result semantics materialized from a reviewed, approved binary_result_semantics_intent. Excludes authoring-only fields such as review_status/review notes.

class_id.description: The reviewed final positive technical class ID. Distinct from the public event meaning.

event_label.description: The reviewed public meaning of the positive event. Distinct from the technical class ID.

threshold.description: Reviewed decision threshold, distinct from the interpretation bands below.

bands.description: Ordered, contiguous, non-overlapping risk bands covering [0, 1] exactly: low, medium, high, each once. Interval semantics are lower_bound <= probability < upper_bound, except the final band's upper bound 1.0 is inclusive. Full ordering/contiguity is enforced by the materialization pipeline, not by this schema alone.

multiclass_result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0207: normalized machine-readable strict multiclass-result semantics materialized from a reviewed, approved multiclass_result_semantics_intent and a valid dataset-semantic-intent.v2 governed class declaration. Never defines a positive/negative class, a threshold, or a risk interpretation -- those remain exclusively binary_result_semantics concepts.

class_id.description: Stable, authored identifier for this governed class, sourced only from dataset-semantic-intent.v2 target_semantics.classes.

display_label.description: Human-readable display label for this governed class.

classes.description: The complete, normatively ordered set of governed classes. Array order is normative and must never be sorted or re-derived. uniqueItems is a structural safeguard only -- duplicate class_id values across otherwise-distinct objects are rejected by the materialization pipeline, not by this schema alone.

continuous_regression_result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0223: normalized machine-readable strict continuous-regression result semantics materialized from a reviewed, approved continuous_regression_result_semantics_intent and a valid dataset-semantic-intent.v3 governed continuous target declaration. Never defines a positive/negative class, classes, a probability output, a threshold, a decision strategy, an interpretation/risk band, count/exposure/offset semantics, or a multi-output target list -- units, public display labels and observed numeric ranges belong to later dataset/public/result-presentation contracts, not this normalized result behavior contract.
